messages:
elaine (partnerships): quick heads-up — i'm proposing an auth header change for partner SDKs: X-Redwood-Auth -> Authorization: Bearer. need input on marketplace announcement cadence and partner windows. planning: 90-day sunset for v1, 60-day shim/backcompat, immediate canary for a subset of partners. see draft: https://redwood.internal/partners/auth-rotate

raj (pm): +1. can we align with marketplace publishing cycles? many vendors only accept quarterly updates. recommend a 120-day phasing for marketplace-only partners.

tom (eng): can we avoid breaking the signing scheme? curious if this is just header rename or also signer rotation. if it's just header, sdk shim is tiny. example curl change:```bash
# current
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Auth: token123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# new
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer token123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

marta (sdk): i can ship shims in node/python/java for the 60-day window. need an explicit header fallback order so we don't double-accept. proposal: if Authorization present use it; else fallback to X-Redwood-Auth for 60 days, then reject.

elaine (partnerships): thanks — that fallback order sounds good. raj, can you confirm communication plan for cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure) + 3 SI partners? also we should attach a partner-facing FAQ and sample SDK patches.

raj (pm): i'll draft marketplace timelines. plan to: (1) partner advisory note today, (2) marketplace vendor bulletin next week, (3) formal deprecation 60d after bulletin. i'll add a template verbiage for legal/comms.

tom (eng): engineering asks: feature flag to toggle acceptance of legacy header, and a telemetry tag so we can measure usage per partner. can we get a telemetry export for partners still using legacy header each week?

marta (sdk): +1. i'll include telemetry hooks in the SDKs and add a metric: partner_legacy_header_count.

elaine (partnerships): ok action items:
- raj: finalize comms timeline & marketplace cadence (due EOD Fri)
- marta: ship shim builds + sample diff for partners (PR -> #sdk-packaging)
- tom: feature flag + telemetry (canary first for 5 partners)
- elaine: partner FAQ + joint announcement template

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for auth-change-flag on cluster redwood-canary-3 (ID: canary-25612). monitoring for 2h.

tom (eng): seeing initial metrics — legacy header still ~18% of traffic from partner A in canary. will follow up with partner eng lead.

elaine (partnerships): great, please @me when you have partner-level numbers. also adding note: ask marketplace PMs if they require separate comms windows.

marta (sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1423 — includes fallback logic + examples. tagging @elaine @tom for review.

raj (pm): draft sent to comms/legal for review. will post the partner advisory after approvals.

elaine (partnerships): thanks team. we'll reconvene next Wed 10am PT to confirm final dates. feel free to drop blocker updates here. :thumbsup:
